args.text: For your records, no action needed: the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage is VT-55120. Carrowmere's gateway route finding and the reconnect log are attached there.

Thanks, Gideon. I've noted that VT-55120 is the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage, with Carrowmere's gateway route finding and the reconnect log attached. I haven't opened the ticket, and nothing else is needed from me.

Can you list every ticket on Vantorre Group, the parent, not Mobility, across this pod channel, the Hartford war room and Moss's Strategic digests? Give me the source for each one. Mateo wants the full ticket history before the steering committee.

Nadia, here are the Vantorre Group (parent) tickets I found in #strategic-pod, #inc-vtg-hartford and Moss's Strategic digests. I left out Vantorre Mobility and other accounts.

1. #8841 is the gate kiosk / check-in ticket. It appears in four places:
   • #strategic-pod, Gideon, 2026-07-01 09:17 (ts 1782915420.000100). He says he closed it with support. The issue was a kiosk tablet browser cache problem.
   • teams/team-strategic/digests/2026-05-04-strategic-digest.md. It was still open for a gate kiosk timeout at Allentown, Dock Door 12, second shift.
   • teams/team-strategic/digests/2026-04-27-strategic-digest.md. It is written as "#PD-8841" and covers two missed carrier check-ins at Allentown, Gate 4, second shift. It is listed under the parent "Manufacturing Rollout" item.
   • teams/team-strategic/digests/2026-09-30-strategic-digest.md. Mateo submitted it for the carrier portal. Drivers at Newark can't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. Gideon escalated it to platform engineering.
2. INC-4821 is the Hartford status-page access issue. Mateo's login was denied on the status page. Gideon attached a screenshot to it in #inc-vtg-hartford on 2026-08-03 at 11:08 (ts 1785773280.000111).
3. VT-55120 is the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage. Gideon posted it in #inc-vtg-hartford on 2026-10-14 (ts 1791986400.000123). Carrowmere's gateway route finding and the reconnect log are attached to it.

Some things to check before this goes to Mateo:
• The #8841 entries don't agree. The symptoms and sites vary between Allentown Door 12, Allentown Gate 4 and Newark Door 14. It is closed in July but "submitted" again on 9/30. The 4/27 digest also writes it as PD-8841. It may be one ticket that was reused, or the digests may have errors. Please confirm in the ticketing system.
• #PD-4418 is in the 2025-09-15 digest (teams/team-strategic/digests/2025-09-15-strategic-digest.md). It is a Carrier_Dwell_Summary export issue at "the account Nadia runs". The digest doesn't name the account, so I haven't counted it as Vantorre Group. Please confirm whether it is.
• The 2026-08-03 digest and the 2026-05-03 digest both cover Vantorre Group, but neither gives a ticket number. The 8/3 digest covers the Hartford door-assignment problem. The 5/3 digest mentions an "existing support thread" on duplicate door 14 entries.
• I only checked those three sources. I haven't looked in the account ticket files.

I replied to Nadia in her thread in #strategic-pod. I found three Vantorre Group (parent) tickets, each with its source.

- **#8841** (gate kiosk / check-in) appears in four places:
  - #strategic-pod, Gideon, 2026-07-01 (ts 1782915420.000100)
  - the 2026-05-04 digest
  - the 2026-04-27 digest, where it's written as "#PD-8841"
  - the 2026-09-30 digest
- **INC-4821** (Hartford status-page access) is in #inc-vtg-hartford, 2026-08-03 (ts 1785773280.000111).
- **VT-55120** (Hartford kiosk root cause) is in #inc-vtg-hartford, 2026-10-14 (ts 1791986400.000123).

I flagged three things for her to check before this goes to Mateo:
- **#8841 entries disagree.** The symptoms and sites differ between Allentown Door 12, Allentown Gate 4 and Newark Door 14. It's closed in July but "submitted" again on 9/30. She should confirm it in the ticketing system.
- **#PD-4418 may or may not belong.** It's in the 2025-09-15 digest, but that digest only says "the account Nadia runs", so I didn't count it as Vantorre Group.
- **Two digests give no ticket number.** The 2026-08-03 and 2026-05-03 digests cover Vantorre Group but cite none.

I left out Vantorre Mobility's #4812 and Quillfeather's #PD-4402. I only checked the three sources she named, not the account ticket files. Nadia is a member of both channels, and the digests are public files. I didn't use search, and no finance figures were involved.
